name: Goblin Smuggler
issues: 'Another target creature with power 2 or less': the ability has no TARGET-mode Selector at all. The target is referenced only by FAtom(IS_ANY_TARGET) anaphora in PREVENT_EFFECT.condition and DeclareBlockersEvent.blocked. activation_target_slots (query.py:1156-1236) yields no slot (a read-only probe returned []), so nothing is designated. The prevention record gets targets=() and IS_ANY_TARGET never matches, so no creature ever becomes unblockable: the ability is a do-nothing tap.

Even with a target, the 'power 2 or less' and 'another' restrictions sit in the block-time event filter instead of target legality. Power would be re-checked at declare-blockers, so a creature pumped above 2 after resolution loses the evasion, and targeting rules (hexproof, protection, an illegal target on resolution) never apply.
notes: Severe: the only non-keyword ability does nothing at runtime. Known engine gap: BACKLOG 'Weaker than printed' names FDN Goblin Smuggler, M21 Subira and ZNR Sneaking Guide. The M21 Subira, Tulzidi Caravanner golden has the identical shape, so golden parity does not prove correctness here. Exclude until the activation lane designates IS_ANY_TARGET-only effects (or the compiler emits a TARGET selector). Haste and the {T} cost are correct.

issues: 'If you search your library this way, shuffle.': SHUFFLE(LIBRARY) is unconditional inside the optional Seq, so the library is shuffled even when the card comes from the graveyard. The tree also gives no choice of which zone(s) to search: one ONE_OF pick over GRAVEYARD + LIBRARY. Recorded known residual (KNOWLEDGE/2026-09-30/19-round18a-silent-semantic-fixes.md:113-116).

'reveal it': REVEAL(controller=you, count=1) names no object; the executor reveals/records the top card of your library (verbs.py _look), not the found card. No visible effect today because the per-seat view tracks no reveals.

'put it into your hand': an extra MOVE_ZONE whose selector is IS_SOURCE (the Elk itself) at LIBRARY TOP -> hand. The found card actually reaches hand through SEARCH's own destination, and this tail is a deliberate no-op (verbs.py:239-246), but the tree's anaphora is wrong.
notes: Trample + optional ETB tutor for 'Vivien, Nature's Avenger' with a conditional shuffle. Tree is byte-identical (modulo the name) to M21 goldens Chandra's Firemaw / Garruk's Warsteed / Teferi's Wavecaster, which share all three defects. Gameplay impact is low: an unwanted shuffle. Without Vivien in the deck, firing the may only shuffles your library (empty ONE_OF picks nothing, selectors.py:792-793), so in practice it is a 5-mana 3/3 trampler.

name: Goldmane Griffin
issues: 'search your library and/or graveyard': the zone choice is collapsed into one SEARCH over GRAVEYARD+LIBRARY (ONE_OF). The player can never search only the graveyard, so 'If you search your library this way, shuffle' becomes an unconditional SHUFFLE whenever the may is accepted.
'reveal it': REVEAL(controller=YOU, count=1) has no object role. Under the executor's REVEAL convention (verbs.py _look) it reveals the top card of your library, not the found card.

'put it into your hand' is encoded twice: SEARCH already has destination HAND, plus an extra MOVE_ZONE(cards=IS_SOURCE on LIBRARY TOP -> HAND), which literally means 'move this creature from the top of your library'. It is a no-op only because the executor guards this 'SEARCH tail' idiom (verbs.py:236-261).
notes: FLYING and VIGILANCE keywords are correct. name: Sorin's Guide
issues: 'search your library and/or graveyard': the zone choice is collapsed into one SEARCH over GRAVEYARD+LIBRARY (ONE_OF). The player can never search only the graveyard, so 'If you search your library this way, shuffle' becomes an unconditional SHUFFLE whenever the may is accepted.
'reveal it': REVEAL(controller=YOU, count=1) has no object role. Under the executor's REVEAL convention (verbs.py _look) it reveals the top card of your library, not the found card.

'put it into your hand' is encoded twice: SEARCH already has destination HAND, plus an extra MOVE_ZONE(cards=IS_SOURCE on LIBRARY TOP -> HAND), which literally means 'move this creature from the top of your library'. It is a no-op only because the executor guards this 'SEARCH tail' idiom (verbs.py:236-261).

name: Yanling's Harbinger
issues: 'If you search your library this way, shuffle': compiled as an unconditional SHUFFLE(LIBRARY) inside the optional Seq, and 'library and/or graveyard' is collapsed into one SEARCH over both zones. Every accepted search shuffles the library, even when the card comes from the graveyard, and the printed choice to search only the graveyard (keeping a known library top) is lost.

'reveal it': compiled as REVEAL(count 1, controller YOU), which the executor treats as revealing the top card of your library (verbs.py _look, top-N-of-library convention), not the card found. The wrong object is revealed.

'put it into your hand': compiled as an extra MOVE_ZONE whose selector is IS_SOURCE (the Harbinger itself) in LIBRARY TOP, not the found card (it should be referent='result' or just the SEARCH destination). At runtime it is a no-op ('13a SEARCH tail' lane, verbs.py ~236-262; SEARCH already delivered the card), but it is a wrong atom in the tree the network reads.
notes: Tree is byte-identical (except the name) to main's M21 golden Teferi's Wavecaster, so that golden carries the same defect. The shuffle issue is a recorded known residual (KNOWLEDGE/2026-09-30/19-round18a-silent-semantic-fixes.md). It is fixed on the unmerged branch cards/integration, where Wavecaster becomes Choose{both zones+shuffle | library+shuffle | graveyard only} and the bogus tail is gone: recompile after the era merge before admitting. Gameplay impact is low. If Mu Yanling, Celestial Wind is not in the pool, the trigger is an optional search that finds nothing, then a shuffle. Tier 3: optional ETB, two-zone search, conditional shuffle. Flying keyword is correct.

name: Act of Treason
notes: Seq[GAIN_CONTROL of a TARGET creature for YOU until end of turn, UNTAP referent=target, GRANT HASTE referent=result until end of turn]. Byte-identical to the first three steps of the M21 Traitorous Greed golden. UNTAP writes the result register (verbs.py _set_tapped), so 'it' binds correctly. Tier 4 because the temporary control change (the executor control overlay, verbs.py:1818) interacts with sacrifice outlets, blocks and the end-of-turn reversion.
